name: Jordan
description: Jordan from Jericho's neighbours and Petra to the Romans, Islam, the Ottomans, the Hashemite kingdom and today.

checkpoints.name: Ancient lands
checkpoints.note: Early farmers settled. The Nabataeans built Petra.

checkpoints.name: Rome to the Ottomans
checkpoints.note: Rome took Petra in 106. The land became Muslim, and the Ottomans ruled from 1516.

checkpoints.name: The kingdom
checkpoints.note: The Arab Revolt began in 1916. Abdullah founded Transjordan, independent in 1946.
